messages:
Nina: quick check-in re dedicated GPU pool scaling semantics — RFC left ambiguity around soft-prewarm vs burst when operator replies late.
Theo: saw a soft prewarm eviction yesterday; tenant hit ~2m cold start. we need deterministic retry/fallback.
Cam: propose explicit intent handshake: control-plane POSTs intent blob; operator must ACK accept/reject within 10s, else fallback triggers.
Ria: intent fields suggestion: target_slots, min_slots, prewarm_type, deadline_ms, fallback_policy (spill|queue|deny), contract_version.
Lee: operator reply should include provision_id, allocated_slots, est_warmup_ms, burst_budget, provision_ttl_ms, trace_id.
Mina: probe spec: if accepted but not materialized by ttl, control-plane marks failed and may reissue intent to another shard with backoff.
Theo: include min_acceptable_slots so partial allocations < min cause a reject semantics. avoids noisy partial success.
Cam: default fallback for latency-sensitive tenants = spill_to_burst, but control-plane must enforce burst caps and circuit breakers to prevent noisy neighbors.
Ria: required metrics: intent_ack_latency_ms, provision_outcome{success|fail}, provision_ttl_expiry_count, and trace_id in logs for audits.
Lee: action items: Cam -> draft microcontract PR; Mina+infra -> probe endpoint ticket; Ria -> add sim test in autoscale suite to emulate accepted-then-dies; Nina -> post follow-up RFC PR by EOD.
Nina: ok if no objections i'll open the PR. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: created INF-3001 for probe endpoint and basic intent metrics plumbing.
